title: smime-tree: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 used for new encryptions — should use OAEP
description: build_rsa_recipient in encrypt.rs wraps the CEK with Pkcs1v15Encrypt. PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport is vulnerable to Bleichenbacher padding oracle attacks (CVE-1998-0036 and descendants). RFC 8017 §7.2 explicitly recommends OAEP for new applications. RFC 5751 §2.3.3 allows RSAES-OAEP for S/MIME. New encryptions should default to RSAES-OAEP. PKCS#1 v1.5 can be retained as a deprecated compatibility path, not the default.
